text: The calendar was just whatever I wrote on there. High school is the same as college, the same as pro, essentially. It's just that the weight might change and the speeds might change per athlete, but that's subjective and specific to the athlete. In a general sense, they all need about the same thing. The pros just need a higher level and a little bit more care for their body because of contracts. The college ones are trying to adapt as much as they can, and the high school ones just have to do a lot of work. Either way, all of them need it accordingly.
